body.title: Ollama preflight + env on the activity-mode spawn path
body.summary: In CliProvider.activityReview (src/agent/providers/cli-provider.ts:610-627): add `await this.checkOllama()` first, compute `childEnv = this.withOllama(process.env) ?? undefined` when this.ollama is set, and pass `env: childEnv` into the runInProcessGroup activity call. Bounded path (runClaude :826, checkOllama :813, withOllama :803-811) semantics reused verbatim.
acceptanceChecks: activityReview awaits this.checkOllama() at the top, before args are built and before parser.start()
childEnv = this.withOllama(process.env) computed when this.ollama is set
runInProcessGroup activity call passes ...(childEnv ? { env: childEnv } : {})
when childEnv is undefined the call is byte-identical to today (process-group.ts:136 spreads only when set)
a rejected preflight throws OllamaTargetError before any child spawn; runReviewSession rethrows un-retried
